payload.title: Handle short HTTP reads and nonobject model-list JSON in vLLM readiness
payload.summary: P2: VLLMServer.status against a healthy owned-container fake returns readyFalse when valid matching /v1/models JSON arrives after a legal short read. A complete valid JSON [] or null instead raises AttributeError through .get rather than established conservative runningTrue/readyFalse. _http_get consumes only one read(65536); _probe_model_ready assumes dict root. Repair narrow existing readiness mechanics; preserve alias match/mismatch, malformed response, cancellation and timeout controls without a new HTTP framework. Baseline a7a49cc18f3b40a5bf4e3897ca30d9a5cddc30d1. Acceptance: Valid matching alias with split header/body is ready; nonobject listing refuses readiness without AttributeError; wrong/missing alias remains false; all owned response streams close; source of liveness versus readiness distinct.
payload.benefit: Make the existing supported boundary conservative and reliable without inventing new lifecycle or authority.
payload.uncertainty: Deterministic maintained-call probes, not live model/GPU/Docker proof. Production correction is not authorized by this audit; preserve ownership and public compatibility.
dependencies: Existing ADR-0001 ModelInteraction/Serving ownership and current public error/JSON/config contracts; no new architectural approval implied.
